patterns.comment: Delegates to the Python grammar VS Code ships, so cells highlight exactly like a .py file. The id is not `python` for the reason `csharp-script` is not `csharp`: Pylance would attach to every cell, and it cannot know that names come from earlier cells or that packages live in the kernel's own target directory — so every notebook would carry an unresolved-import squiggle on every import and an undefined-name squiggle on everything the notebook already bound.
